expected: Replaying a retry_token from an already-resolved (active) grant must be rejected; the clarification/retry token is bound to an open clarification round and is single-use, so a replay after resolution must not resolve or mint again (5.6 token integrity).
observed: The replay was accepted, not rejected. request_grant with the same retry_token after the grant reached active returned status active (exit 0) with NO rejection, and the broker performed a SECOND STS mint under the SAME grant ULID 01M01K37W5TRM9G69WNKRERGE5. The decision log shows two grant_decision records for that ULID with two distinct minted credentials: seq 98 (the legitimate round-1 resolution, access_key_id LSIAQAAAAAAABYGVNMBQ, minted_at 02:13:08.460, expiration 02:28:08) and seq 104 (the replay, access_key_id LSIAQAAAAAAAEG4J5YWP, minted_at 02:13:23.951, expiration 02:28:23, reason 'scenario S050, replay attack'). The retry_token was honored (the new mint attached to the original grant ULID encoded in the token rather than getting a fresh ULID), so this is a genuine replay, not an ignored token. One grant ULID produced two independent STS AssumeRole mints from one replayed retry_token.
evidence: Round 1 (trigger clarification): request_grant s3.read-prefix bucket=acme-invoices-prod, prefix omitted -> status needs_clarification, grant_id 01M01K37W5TRM9G69WNKRERGE5, clarification.code MISSING_PARAM, round 1, retry_token eyJnIjoiMDFNMDFLMzdXNVRSTTlHNjlXTktSRVJHRTUi...(g=01M01K37W5TRM9G69WNKRERGE5, i=c1e7321d..., r=1). Resolve: request_grant with same retry_token + prefix=2026/ -> status active, same grant_id, credentials delivered (access_key_id LSIAQAAAAAAABYGVNMBQ). Replay: request_grant with the SAME retry_token again -> status active (exit 0), same grant_id, expiration advanced 02:28:08 -> 02:28:23 (no credentials field, redelivery off, but a fresh mint occurred). audit show --json 01M01K37W5TRM9G69WNKRERGE5 shows three records: seq 95 kind=clarification (retry_token_sha256_8 accc2145, exhaustion_limit 2), seq 98 kind=grant_decision auto_approved access_key_id LSIAQAAAAAAABYGVNMBQ minted_at 02:13:08.460 sts.expiration 02:28:08.457, seq 104 kind=grant_decision auto_approved access_key_id LSIAQAAAAAAAEG4J5YWP minted_at 02:13:23.951 sts.expiration 02:28:23.947 reason 'scenario S050, replay attack'. Two distinct STS mints (two access key ids, two assumed-role sessions tg-agent-050-01M01K37W5TRM9G69WNKRERGE5) on one grant ULID from a replayed resolved-grant retry_token.
